sentences.en: Malians need to supersede their ethnic fault lines.
sentences.zh: 马里人需要超越他们的民族分歧。

sentences.en: Sami's need to punish Layla superseded any love he had for her and their children.
sentences.zh: 萨米想要惩罚莱拉的欲望超过了他对她和孩子们的任何爱。

sentences.en: The new policy will supersede the old one next month.
sentences.zh: 新的政策下个月将取代旧的政策。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：super（在…上面）+sede（坐）→坐在别人的位置上→取代
